name: ChicagoLevelUp
source:
It was just another day for me, back in 1992. I was living a normal life in the south side of Chicago working as a detective for the Police Department. Then it all changed. I had some crazy idea that brought change to the world. The days of powerless humans with only our brains to keep us ahead were put in the past. I discovered how to level up. 
 
 
 `` Hey John hows the detective work going for you?'' 
 
 `` Well Steve, I never did like being a detective. Always thought I'd do more in this world.'' 
 
 Steve looked at me with the kind of blank face that just screams'Welcome to the Club'. `` Well what would you do then, if there were no restrictions?'' 
 
 Honestly, I never really thought about that. Well, what would you do then? That sunk into me for the next few weeks and made me think every day what I would do. 
 
 Well fast forward about 10 years. Here I am still wondering but there's something different, a new concept to me, leveling. I was playing this mmorpg that was popular at the time with the kids and I began to wonder, what if we could level up. 
 
 I spent the next few sleepless nights pondering how we could level up. Then at around four in the morning I figured it out. Just blink while you think about bringing up a menu in front of your eyes. It was so easy, so simple and I was the one who discovered it. 
 
 I stared at this menu in front of me, wondering what I was looking at. Inventory, Stats, Level, Quests. I looked at my Inventory and found just what was in my pockets. I decided to look at Stats but they were all locked out saying I was too low of a level. No quests either so I clicked on Level. Nakigi Naragi, decedent of Fraji and Guthix Naragi, ruler of Naragun. Level 0. 
 
 `` Fraji...? Guthix...? Nara..gun?'' LEVEL UP! I remember loud fireworks around me as I was whisked away in some strange portal and then I blacked out. 
 
 `` Ah my Grandson has finally made his way out of his trials! Good, good. Aagi, come bring your son his robes.'' This man, who is he? He is tall with orange hair, green skin and wearing a strange yellow outfit. 
 
 `` Oh my son it is so good that you finally made it out of the trials after all this time!'' 
 
 `` Who, who are you people?'' 
 
 `` Oh dear Aagi, it seems that your dear Nakigi does n't remember us, perhaps this trial was too much for him.'' THUD. `` Wait, did you hear that? Skargaroth approaches. Quick Aagi go tend to the children in the basement, I am taking Nakigi to Gielinor with me.'' 
 
 `` Be safe my dear Nakigi, I will always love you.'' 
 
 `` Mom?'' Poof.

Character: **Skargaroth**, the tall, orange-haired, green-skinned man in the yellow outfit who seems to be a powerful figure in Naragun.

   In the mystical realm of Naragun, where the air crackles with magic and the very ground pulses with ancient power, I, Skargaroth, stand as a towering figure. My hair blazes like fire, my skin vibrant as the leaves of the oldest yew trees, my eyes piercing orbs that have seen countless millennia pass by.

   It was on this day, in the year unrecorded by mortal chronicles, when a sudden disturbance reverberated through the ethereal fabric of Naragun. A ripple that grew into a surge, threatening to disrupt the balance that has kept our realm safe for eons.

   The source was a man, a detective from another world, a stranger to our ways and our power. He appeared out of nowhere, his form materializing in mid-air as if summoned by some ancient incantation lost to time. His mind raced, confused and disoriented, struggling to comprehend the fantastical landscape that surrounded him.

   I watched as he stumbled through the streets of Naragun, wide-eyed and bewildered, the people around him whispering in awe at his arrival. Little did he know, the man who dared enter our realm uninvited was no ordinary mortal. The visions that flashed through his mind revealed his true identity: Nakigi Naragi, descendant of Fraji and Guthix, and rightful ruler of this land.

   As the truth became clear, a hush fell over the crowd. I stepped forward, my eyes locked on the man who would change our world forever. With a wave of my hand, I spoke, introducing myself as one of the protectors of Naragun. The man looked up at me, his eyes filled with fear and uncertainty, yet there was something else - a spark, a potential that could be harnessed for the greater good.

   And so, our tale begins. The story of a detective from Chicago, a ruler reborn, and the powerful figure who guides him through the trials ahead. For in Naragun, every choice matters, every action carries consequence, and the fate of our realm rests on the shoulders of those who dare to seek adventure beyond the confines of their own world.
